price_lists_scope_target_check.name: price_lists_scope_target_check
price_lists_scope_target_check.value:
("price_lists"."scope" = 'standard' and "price_lists"."customer_id" is null and "price_lists"."segment" is null)
        or ("price_lists"."scope" = 'customer' and "price_lists"."customer_id" is not null)
        or ("price_lists"."scope" = 'segment' and "price_lists"."segment" is not null)

targets_assignment_check.name: targets_assignment_check
targets_assignment_check.value: "targets"."seller_id" is not null or "targets"."territory_id" is not null
